rewrites.//: The archive is a React Router SPA, so any path under /netflix that is not a real file has to be handed to its index.html for the client router to resolve. No exclusion for /netflix/assets is needed: Vercel serves static files BEFORE it applies rewrites, so the real bundles win and only routes fall through. The current site at / is a single static page and needs no fallback of its own, so an unknown top-level path correctly 404s.
